title: Between vulnerability and resilience: A network analysis of fluctuations in cognitive risk and protective factors following remission from depression
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subjects network
limitations: - ESM procedure limited in number of variables that can be repeatedly assessed; - Subjective resilience ratings may overlap with positive appraisal and positive affect; - Data limited to 7 days, not diagnostic for recurrence; - Sample focused on RMD patients, not generalizable to other disorders.
notes: The study used a pre-registered protocol on OSF (osf.io/g2k4w). The code and data are declared available, but specific links or repositories are not provided in the paper. The centrality test was based on visual inspection, not formal statistical testing.
